description: Convert up to 100 mixed timestamps (ISO 8601, RFC 2822, Unix seconds/ms/us/ns, slash dates, short date phrases) to UTC and local ISO 8601, flagging ambiguous day/month order.

locale.description: Language of the text. en reads 03/04 as March 4; en-GB as 3 April. Default en.

reference.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time that relative phrases are resolved against (e.g. "2026-11-11T09:00:00-07:00"). Default: current server time.

timezone.description: IANA time zone for reading and reporting local times, e.g. "America/Denver". Default UTC.

name: normalize_timestamps
title: Normalize mixed timestamps
